urls.title: URLs
urls.description: Public HTTP(S) pages; duplicates are removed before capture.

viewport.title: Viewport preset
viewport.description: Runtime default desktop. Mobile uses a mobile UA, touch, and device scale 3.

format.title: Image format
format.description: Runtime default png. WebP is converted from lossless PNG.

pdfFormat.title: PDF paper size
pdfFormat.description: Runtime default A4; PDF includes the whole page even for element images.

waitStrategy.title: Wait strategy
waitStrategy.description: Runtime default load; networkidle may time out on pages with background traffic.

waitDelaySeconds.title: Fixed delay
waitDelaySeconds.description: Used by fixed strategy; runtime default 2.

elementSelector.title: Element CSS selector
elementSelector.description: Optional: capture only the first matching visible element.

css.title: Custom CSS
css.description: Optional CSS only, at most 20,000 characters; no JavaScript.

timeoutSeconds.title: Per-page timeout
timeoutSeconds.description: Runtime default 60; includes robots checks, loading and capture.

maxConcurrency.title: Concurrent pages
maxConcurrency.description: Runtime default 2; all pages share one browser.

fullPage.title: fullPage
fullPage.description: Runtime default true. Ignored for element capture.

pdf.title: pdf
pdf.description: Also save a PDF; runtime default false.

printBackground.title: printBackground
printBackground.description: Include PDF background colors/images; runtime default true.

hideCookieBanners.title: hideCookieBanners
hideCookieBanners.description: Hide known CMP overlays and conservative cookie dialogs; does not grant consent. Default true.

blockAds.title: blockAds
blockAds.description: Block a short maintained list of ad and analytics domains. Default false.

scrollPage.title: scrollPage
scrollPage.description: Bounded scrolling for lazy images before capture. Default true.
